concepts.name: Classification system

concepts.name: Coherence
concepts.description: Adequacy of statistics to be reliably combined in different ways and for various uses.

concepts.name: Coherence - cross domain
concepts.description: Extent to which statistics are reconcilable with those obtained through other data sources or statistical domains.

concepts.name: Coherence - internal

concepts.name: Coherence - National Accounts

concepts.name: Coherence - sub-annual and annual statistics

concepts.name: Comment
concepts.description: Descriptive text which can be attached to data or metadata.

concepts.name: Comparability
concepts.description: Extent to which differences between statistics can be attributed to differences between the true values of the statistical characteristics.

concepts.name: Comparability - geographical
concepts.description: Extent to which statistics are comparable between geographical areas.

concepts.name: Comparability - over time
concepts.description: Extent to which statistics are comparable or reconcilable over time.

concepts.name: Confidentiality - policy
concepts.description: Legislative measures or other formal procedures which prevent unauthorised disclosure of data that identify a person or economic entity either directly or indirectly.

concepts.name: Confidentiality - status

concepts.name: Contact phone number

concepts.description: Cost associated with the collection and production of a statistical product, as well as the burden imposed on respondents.

concepts.name: Currency

concepts.description: Method applied for gathering data for official statistics.

concepts.name: Data compilation

concepts.name: Data presentation - detailed description
concepts.description: Detailed description of the disseminated data.

concepts.name: Data presentation - summary description
concepts.description: Main characteristics of the data set described in an easily understandable manner, referring to the data and indicators disseminated.

concepts.name: Data provider
concepts.description: Organisation or individual that reports or disseminates data or reference metadata.

concepts.name: Data revision - practice
concepts.description: Information on the data revision practice.

concepts.name: Data revision - studies
concepts.description: Information about data revision studies and analyses.

concepts.name: Data validation
concepts.description: Process of monitoring the results of data compilation and ensuring the quality of the statistical results.

concepts.name: Decimals
concepts.description: Number of digits of an observation to the right of a decimal point.

concepts.name: Dissemination format
concepts.description: Media by which statistical data and metadata are disseminated.

concepts.name: Dissemination format - microdata access
concepts.description: Information on whether micro-data are also disseminated.

concepts.name: Dissemination format - news release
concepts.description: Regular or ad-hoc press releases linked to the data.

concepts.name: Dissemination format - online database
concepts.description: Information about on-line databases in which the disseminated data can be accessed.

concepts.name: Dissemination format - publications
concepts.description: Regular or ad-hoc publications in which the data are made available to the public.

concepts.name: Dissemination format - other formats
concepts.description: References to the most important other data dissemination done.

concepts.name: Documentation on methodology
concepts.description: Descriptive text and references to methodological documents available.

concepts.name: Documentation on methodology - advance notice
concepts.description: Policy on notifying the public of changes in methodology, indicating whether the public is notified before a methodological change affects disseminated data and, if so, how long before.

concepts.description: Time interval at which the source data are collected.

concepts.name: Frequency of dissemination
concepts.description: Time interval at which the statistics are disseminated over a given time period.

concepts.name: Frequency of observation
concepts.description: Time interval at which observations occur over a given time period.

concepts.description: Ratio of the number of replaced values to the total number of values for a given variable.

concepts.description: Set of rules or other formal set of instructions assigning responsibility as well as the authority to an organisation for the collection, processing, and dissemination of statistics.

concepts.name: Institutional mandate - data sharing
concepts.description: Arrangements or procedures for data sharing and coordination between data producing agencies.

concepts.name: Institutional mandate - legal acts and other agreements
concepts.description: Legal acts or other formal or informal agreements that assign responsibility as well as the authority to an agency for the collection, processing, and dissemination of statistics.

concepts.name: Item non-response rate
concepts.description: Ratio between the in-scope (eligible) units which have not responded to a particular item and the in-scope units that are required to respond to that particular item.

concepts.name: Maintenance agency
concepts.description: Organisation or other expert body responsible for the operational maintenance of commonly used metadata artefacts.

concepts.name: Measurement error
concepts.description: Error in reading, calculating or recording a numerical value.

concepts.name: Metadata completeness
concepts.description: Ratio of the number of metadata elements provided to the total number of metadata elements applicable.

concepts.name: Metadata update
concepts.description: Date on which the metadata element was created or modified.

concepts.name: Metadata update - last certified
concepts.description: Date of the latest certification provided by the domain manager to confirm that the metadata posted are still up-to-date, even if the content has not been amended.

concepts.name: Metadata update - last posted
concepts.description: Date of the latest dissemination of the metadata.

concepts.name: Metadata update - last update
concepts.description: Date of last update of the content of the metadata.

concepts.name: Model assumption error
concepts.description: Error that occurs due the use of methods, such as calibration, generalised regression estimator, calculation based on full scope or constant scope, benchmarking, seasonal adjustment and other models n

concepts.name: Non-response error
concepts.description: Error that occurs when the survey fails to get a response to one, or possibly all, of the questions.

concepts.name: Non-sampling error
concepts.description: Error in sample estimates which cannot be attributed to sampling fluctuations.

concepts.name: Number of data table consultations
concepts.description: Number of consultations of data tables within a statistical domain for a given time period.

concepts.name: Number of metadata consultations
concepts.description: Number of metadata file consultations within a statistical domain for a given time period.

concepts.name: Observation pre-break value
concepts.description: Observation, at a time series break period, that was calculated using the old methodology.

concepts.name: Observation status
concepts.description: Information on the quality of a value or an unusual or missing value.

concepts.name: Observation value
concepts.description: Value of a particular variable.

concepts.name: Occupation
concepts.description: Job or position held by an individual who performs a set of tasks and duties.

concepts.name: Over-coverage rate
concepts.description: Proportion of units accessible via the frame that do not belong to the target population (are out-of-scope).

concepts.name: Price adjustment
concepts.description: Statistical technique used to remove the effects of price influences operating on a data series.

concepts.name: Processing error
concepts.description: Error in final survey results arising from the faulty implementation of correctly planned implementation methods.

concepts.name: Professionalism
concepts.description: Standard, skill and ability suitable for producing statistics of good quality.

concepts.name: Professionalism - code of conduct
concepts.description: Provisions for assuring the qualifications of staff and allowing staff to perform their functions without intervention motivated by non-statistical objectives.

concepts.name: Professionalism - impartiality
concepts.description: Elements providing assurances that statistics are produced on an impartial basis.

concepts.name: Professionalism - methodology
concepts.description: Elements providing assurances that the choices of sources and statistical techniques as well as decisions about dissemination are informed solely by statistical considerations.

concepts.name: Professionalism - statistical commentary
concepts.description: Elements providing assurances that the statistical entity is entitled to comment on erroneous interpretation and misuse of statistics.

concepts.name: Proportion of common units
concepts.description: Proportion of units covered by both the survey and the administrative sources in relation to the total number of units in the survey.

concepts.name: Punctuality
concepts.description: Time lag between the actual delivery of the data and the target date when it should have been delivered.

concepts.name: Quality management
concepts.description: Systems and frameworks in place within an organisation to manage the quality of statistical products and processes.

concepts.name: Quality management - quality assessment
concepts.description: Overall evaluation of data quality, based on standard quality criteria.

concepts.name: Quality management - quality assurance
concepts.description: Guidelines focusing on quality in general and dealing with quality of statistical programmes, including measures for ensuring the efficient use of resources.

concepts.name: Quality management - quality documentation
concepts.description: Documentation on procedures applied for quality management and quality assessment.

concepts.name: Reference area
concepts.description: Country or geographic area to which the measured statistical phenomenon relates.

concepts.name: Reference period
concepts.description: Timespan or point in time to which the measured observation is intended to refer.

concepts.name: Release policy
concepts.description: Rules for disseminating statistical data to interested parties.

concepts.name: Release policy - release calendar
concepts.description: Schedule of statistical release dates.

concepts.name: Release policy - release calendar access
concepts.description: Description of how the release calendar can be accessed.

concepts.name: Release policy - transparency
concepts.description: Statement describing whether and how the release policy is disseminated to the public.

concepts.name: Release policy - user access
concepts.description: Policy for release of the data to users, scope of dissemination (e.g. to the public, to selected users), how users are informed that the data are being released, and whether the policy determines the

concepts.name: Relevance
concepts.description: Degree to which statistical information meets the real or perceived needs of clients.

concepts.name: Relevance - completeness
concepts.description: Extent to which all statistics that are needed are available.

concepts.name: Relevance - user needs
concepts.description: Description of requirements with respect to the statistical output.

concepts.name: Relevance - user satisfaction
concepts.description: Description of how well the disseminated statistics meet the expressed user needs.

concepts.name: Reporting agency
concepts.description: Organisation that supplies the data for a given instance of the statistics.

concepts.name: Sampling error
concepts.description: Part of the difference between a population value and an estimate thereof, derived from a random sample, which is due to the fact that only a subset of the population is enumerated.

concepts.name: Seasonal adjustment
concepts.description: Statistical technique used to remove the effects of seasonal and calendar influences operating on a data series.

concepts.name: Sector coverage
concepts.description: Main economic or other sectors covered by the statistics.

concepts.name: Sex
concepts.description: State of being male or female.

concepts.name: Source data type
concepts.description: Characteristics and components of the raw statistical data used for compiling statistical aggregates.

concepts.name: Statistical concepts and definitions
concepts.description: Description of the statistical domain under measure as well as the main variables provided.

concepts.name: Statistical population
concepts.description: Total membership or population or "universe" of a defined class of people, objects or events.

concepts.name: Statistical unit
concepts.description: Entity for which information is sought and for which statistics are ultimately compiled.

concepts.name: Time coverage
concepts.description: Reference metadata element specifying the period of time for which data are provided.

concepts.name: Time format
concepts.description: Technical format for the representation of time.

concepts.name: Time lag - final results
concepts.description: Number of days (or weeks or months) from the last day of the reference period to the day of publication of complete and final results.

concepts.name: Time lag - first results
concepts.description: Number of days (or weeks or months) from the last day of the reference period to the day of publication of first results.

concepts.name: Timeliness
concepts.description: Length of time between data availability and the event or phenomenon they describe

concepts.name: Timeliness - source data
concepts.description: Time between the end of a reference period and actual receipt of the data by the compiling agency.

concepts.name: Time period
concepts.description: Timespan or point in time to which the observation actually refers.

concepts.name: Time period - collection
concepts.description: Dates or periods during which the observations have been collected (such as middle, average or end of period) for the target reference period.

concepts.name: Time transformation
concepts.description: Time-related operation performed on a time series, solely involving observations of that time series.

concepts.name: Title
concepts.description: Textual label used as identification of a statistical object.

concepts.name: Unit multiplier
concepts.description: Exponent in base 10 specified so that multiplying the observation numeric values by 10^UNIT_MULT gives a value expressed in the unit of measure.

concepts.name: Unit non-response rate
concepts.description: Ratio of the number of units with no information or not usable information to the total number of in-scope (eligible) units.

concepts.name: Unit of measure
concepts.description: Unit in which the data values are expressed.
